26" Beach Cruiser Bike for Men - 1&7 Speed Available
Experience comfort and style with the Tracer Taha Beach Cruiser Bike for Men. Featuring durable 26" wheels and a sturdy Hi-Ten steel frame, this cruiser bike is designed for smooth rides on various terrains. Choose between 1 or 7-speed options, with Shimano components for reliable shifting. The wide tires and comfortable saddle ensure a relaxing ride, whether you're cruising the beach or commuting through the city. With multiple color options, this hybrid bike blends classic design with modern functionality, making it perfect for adults seeking both performance and leisure. Ideal for men ranging from 5' to 6'2" in height, the Tracer Taha is built for comfort, ease, and enjoyment.

EASIER RIDING: The TRACER TAHA beach cruiser is built for your comfort and relaxation. 26"×2.125" Inch Wheels, adult bicycle tires, enough to meet different kinds of rolling, whether a casual riding with families, friends, or for a commuting use. You get to choose two-toned color options that suit your personality.
SAFER RIDING: The Stunning TAHA beach cruiser demonstrates some of the professional components like alloy seat post, coaster brakes, stainless steel spokes, 26’’X2.125” whitewall tires, and colored fenders.
HIGH QUALITY: High quality sealed ISO bottom bracket with Cr-Mo square axle and bearing shells of wrought iron, Hi-Ten Steel Frame and Stainless Steel 14G Spokes.
COMFORT DESIGN: Wide cruiser bar, soft tower cruiser seat with springer, fully stretch your body and arms, making the riding comfortable.
EASY INSTALLATION: Fits riders from 5 feet to 6 feet 2 inches tall; comes 85 percent assembled.

EXTRAS

WEIGHT

The most accurate way to determine any bike’s weight is to have your local dealer weigh it for you. Many brands strive to list the lowest possible weight, but in reality weight can vary based on size, finish, hardware and accessories. All our bikes are designed for best-in-class weight and ride quality.
